Program Coordinator – Office of Campus Organizations & Volunteer Programs (COVP)

The Program Coordinator plays a key role in supporting and empowering nearly 700 Registered Campus Organizations (RCOs) at UCI. This position is responsible for developing and delivering a variety of resources for student organizations, including materials and support for leadership development, event planning, risk management, and RCO advising. The Program Coordinator creates workshops, guides, events, and other tools to help organizations and advisors succeed and stay informed.

This role supports the campus organization registration process, ensuring both new and returning groups have the guidance and resources needed to get started and remain active. The Program Coordinator also helps coordinate COVP’s signature programs and events and provides direct support to new campus organizations as they establish themselves on campus.

In addition, the Program Coordinator works closely with the Assistant Director to support volunteer and community service programs, helping to organize service projects and encourage student involvement in meaningful community engagement. The position collaborates with the Director on program coordination, assessment, and ongoing improvement, and supervises and mentors Campus Organizations Activities Coordinators and student interns. The Program Coordinator also manages departmental marketing and social media, ensuring communications are clear, engaging, and reach the right audiences. Collaboration is a key part of this role, as the Program Coordinator regularly works with a diverse community of students, advisors, faculty, staff, and campus partners.
Overall, this position is focused on building community, supporting student leaders, and helping COVP remain flexible and responsive to campus needs as programs and resources evolve.
